id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

from.description: The email address that will appear in the "From" field of the email

cc.description: A list of email addresses to add to the Cc field

bcc.description: A list of email addresses to add to the Bcc field

dynamicTo.description: A token to use to dynamically populate the {@link Mail#to} field

dynamicCc.description: A token to use to dynamically populate the {@link Mail#cc} field

dynamicBcc.description: A token to use to dynamically populate the {@link Mail#bcc} field

contentTemplateMetaPath.description:
Recommended way of providing the content template. An `html` should be created in the `/resource/` directory and
the path to that resource should be provided here.

Example: `'meta://genAiSearch/resource/emailTemplates/newUserInvitationEmail.html'

contentTemplateString.description:
Alternative to #contentTemplateMetaPath. This is not recommended, but may be easier to update in a
production environment. If using this strategy, please format the string as a valid HTML document.

If a #contentTemplateMetaPath is provided, it will be used instead.

commonReplaceTokens.description:
There are common tokens that are used in multiple email templates. Instead of providing
#customReplaceTokens, which are more difficult to update due to the lambda expression, a list of common
tokens can be provided instead, where the expression is baked into the code base.

customReplaceTokens.description:
For one-off token replacement scenarios or if the token does not exist in
{@link Genai.Mail.Template.CommonReplaceTokenEnum}, a custom token can be provided as a map of the token, including
surrounding `{{double curly braces}}`, and a stringified lambda expression that will be evaluated and will replace
the token.

contentType.description: The content type to use for the email.

title: A template for an email that can be sent to users.
name: Genai.Mail.Template
